answer: Because each tide escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the vault ledger records every share and the mirror audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 189 aliases means 189 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
